meaning: Revision references record available provenance, not a claim that a modified vendored tree equals an upstream checkout. The rc6_archive fields identify the archival input before cleanup and the accepted API fixes. The packaged fields identify the final v1.0.0 source components; bundled source and build instructions are authoritative.
digest_algorithm: SHA256 of sorted UTF-8 relative path + NUL + lowercase file SHA256 + LF, for every regular archive entry under the component path.

components.name: N64ModernRuntime
components.revision_basis: local dependency checkout HEAD; archive contents may include local modifications

components.name: N64Recomp
components.revision_basis: N64ModernRuntime HEAD gitlink; vendored archive content is authoritative

components.name: RT64
components.revision_basis: local dependency checkout HEAD; locally modified fork of https://github.com/rt64/rt64

components.name: RecompFrontend
components.revision_basis: vendored directory; no independent git metadata or exact upstream revision established

components.name: rcheevos
components.revision_basis: pinned upstream revision recorded in archived UPSTREAM.md; local CMake integration

components.name: FreeType Windows binaries
components.revision_basis: FreeType 2.14.1 from archived README and freetype.h; supplied prebuilt static library

components.name: DirectX Shader Compiler
components.revision_basis: The archived dxcompiler.dll version 1.7.0.4147 identifies this historical source commit. Those obsolete Windows compiler binaries are excluded; the current matched build/runtime toolchain is recorded separately in external_dxc_toolchain.

packaged_digest_algorithm: SHA256 of sorted UTF-8 file paths relative to the component directory + NUL + lowercase file SHA256 + LF, for every packaged regular file under that directory.

external_dxc_toolchain.license: University of Illinois/NCSA (LICENSE-LLVM.txt), as assigned by this release's per-file license table.
external_dxc_toolchain.notice: The matched compiler, runtime library and validator are acquired together and checked individually. They build Direct3D and default SPIR-V shaders; selected framebuffer and Wave Race SPIR-V shaders continue to use the separate pinned Vulkan compiler. No 1.8.2502 tool binary is included in this source archive.

external_vulkan_compiler.scope: Selected native framebuffer and Wave Race reflection/shadow SPIR-V shaders; the ordinary SPIR-V shaders use the matched 1.8.2502 toolchain.
